title: Chapter 8 Rebuilding The Deserted City
content:
Chapter 8 Rebuilding The Deserted City

Huangzhou is a remote and poor place, and is regarded as a wild land.

So there are very few people here.

It is often very far away to see such a village or a city.

And because of the lack of spiritual energy, the cultivation of practitioners is also very low, and most of them are in the Qi Refining and Innate.

Once some powerful monsters appear, no one can stop them.

This leads to the unusual unity of the people here.

The same is true in Huangcheng. Lu Daosheng gained the trust of the citizens through his own efforts and strength. After the death of the old city lord, he became the new city lord of Huangcheng.

Now that he has become rich, he naturally cannot forget these citizens.

So Lu Daosheng plans to develop his power, and what he wants to develop is his own Huangcheng.

Although Huangcheng is still very poor now, Lu Daosheng will soon make earth-shaking changes here.

Then, Lu Daosheng slowly closed his eyes.

The next moment, the entire Huangcheng fell into a state of stillness, as if God had pressed the pause button.

On the streets of the city, everyone froze.

Even Gu Chen, who was beside Lu Daosheng, was no exception.

Boom!

All the buildings in the deserted city shattered into nothingness in an instant. Then, Lu Daosheng opened his eyes and took out countless resources and treasures from the system store.

Next, he wanted to rebuild the entire deserted city.

Lu Daosheng stood in the void and received all the creatures in the deserted city into the world in his palm. Then he grabbed a handful of ancient divine gold and some refining materials and began to build a new deserted city.

Ancient divine gold is the hardest material that Lu Daosheng can control at present.

There must be harder materials in the system store, but Lu Daosheng couldn't refine them.

Boom!

While refining the deserted city, Lu Daosheng stretched out his hand to summon the baptism of thunder.

After an unknown period of time, a brand new deserted city appeared in Lu Daosheng's hands.

However, before it was over, Lu Daosheng stretched out his hand again, and countless world laws rolled in from the void, continuously injected into the deserted city.

Suddenly, the whole deserted city was shining with golden light, containing the universe.

Now, this new deserted city is not only extremely solid, but also contains the world's laws. It seems to be only as big as a city, but it can hold a world inside.

The whole deserted city is magnificent and domineering.

Looking at the new deserted city, Lu Daosheng nodded with satisfaction, but seemed to think of something, then bit his finger, took out a taboo ancient card, and began to write two big words with his finger as a pen.

Deserted city!

Suddenly, the aura of the taboo ancient card surged, and a terrifying pressure came from the taboo ancient card, and the whole sky and earth began to tremble violently.

At the same time, countless creatures trembled in their hearts, and the majestic appearance of the new deserted city emerged in their hearts.

Named with the blood of destiny, all spirits come to pay homage.

Then, Lu Daosheng put his hand on the deserted city again.

This time, he injected his own rule power.

It cannot be broken unless you are in the realm of destiny.

Anyone who enters the deserted city must follow his rules.

"Now, this deserted city is famous enough to shake the heavens."

Lu Daosheng smiled slightly.

Looking at the past, present and future, there is probably no one else who can build such a huge city with such a big hand.

Boom!

A new city appeared at the location of the original deserted city, and the name of the new city is still the deserted city.

"Now that the city is there, the things inside cannot be less."

Lu Daosheng muttered to himself, and then began to sweep the system store.

In a short while, in the center of the deserted city, giant trees and towers appeared in the city lord's mansion.

The tree of life, the ancient tree of chaos, the soul tree,

The tower of heaven, the demon god tower, the time and space god tower,

Then, there were some strange and weird things.

These are almost all treasures from legends.

And now, all of them appear in the same place.

Deserted City.

However, it is not over after doing all this. Lu Daosheng dug another river that runs through the entire deserted city.

A winding river appeared in the deserted city.

A river made of the nectar of creation!

Its source flows out from the city lord's mansion and flows all the way to the chaotic void.

Clapping his hands, Lu Daosheng slowly breathed a sigh of relief.

Now this deserted city is completely completed.

Next, let his citizens practice well.

Then, Lu Daosheng put everyone back in the new deserted city.

Snap!

Lu Daosheng snapped his fingers, and everyone woke up immediately.

"Hey, why do I feel weird?"

"Huh~ I suddenly feel refreshed, damn! Why are there so many trees in the City Lord's Mansion!"

"Not only trees, but also many towers."

At this moment, the people in the deserted city who had recovered suddenly exclaimed.

Looking at the familiar but unfamiliar city in front of them, they were all surprised and confused.

But the next moment, a breath overflowed from their bodies.

Breakthrough.

That's right, in this environment, even if everyone did not practice, their realm began to rise.

The Tree of Life, the Ancient Tree of Chaos, in a big world, as long as there is one of them, the world will undergo earth-shaking changes, and all creatures will get twice the result with half the effort in practice.

And now, there are several trees in the deserted city alone.

You can break through even when you lie down and sleep.

Feeling the breakthrough in cultivation, everyone immediately stopped what they were doing and sat cross-legged on the ground.

In the city lord's mansion.

Beside Lu Daosheng, Gu Chen looked at everything in front of him with shock.

With his eyesight, he naturally saw that this was no longer the previous deserted city.

The newly emerging ancient tree pagodas in front of him dazzled him even more.

"City, lord, what did you do?"

Gu Chen said in a trembling voice.

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "It's nothing. It's just rebuilding the deserted city and adding something."

This is nothing? !

If you read that tree correctly, it is the tree of life.

Isn’t that the legendary treasure of heaven and earth?

No one can know where its essence is.

He was just a lucky branch of a tree of life.

"Damn it! That's the ancient tree of enlightenment!!"

Seeing the other direction, the ancient tree full of the aura of the great way, Gu Chen swears directly.

Now, what happened in front of him had somewhat subverted his perception.

Gu Chen suddenly pinched his thigh hard.

"Hiss~I'm not dreaming."

"City Lord, are you the Creation God?"

Gu Chen looked at Lu Daosheng and lost his mind.

All these legendary things appeared in the same place. He could not think of anyone else who could do it except the Creator God.

Seeing Gu Chen's appearance as he had never seen the world, Lu Daosheng touched his nose and smiled, "I am not a god of creation, I am just an ordinary person with some family background and better than others."

Is this an ordinary person? !

Gu Chen took a deep breath, resisted the idea of beating Lu Daosheng, and then lowered his head and said, "City Lord, I, Gu Chen, have never been convinced in my life. Now, City Lord, I am convinced you."

At this time, a crack sounded from the ancient dust body.

Gu Chen, who had been in the Great Emperor Realm for nearly a million years, finally took another step forward.

Promoted to Emperor of Heaven!
